name: Gakuen Choukyou Iinkai ~Mesukyoushi Injoku no Houkago~
original_name: 学園調教委員会～牝教師淫辱の放課後～
source:
One day, the main character, a doll mania, meets a girl who resembles one of his collection dolls. His crooked desire bursts out, and he pounces on her...
